description: Free-tier endpoint. Returns the synthetic daily MLB Grand Salami for a given UTC date — total runs scored across every MLB game on the slate plus each book's implied Grand Salami line (median of per-game primary totals across our MLB books incl. Pinnacle, Polymarket, Matchbook, Smarkets). No retail sportsbook quotes this as a single market. Useful for: 'what's the total run line for tonight's full MLB slate', 'did the Grand Salami go over yesterday', 'historical Grand Salami results for backtesting'.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD UTC date. Defaults to today (UTC) when omitted.

name: propline_get_mlb_grand_salami
title: Get MLB Grand Salami
